findings.desc: CHK-002 and CHK-003 verificationEvidence is not reproducible enough for a formal staging audit. The recorded commands use placeholders like "CHK-001 readiness transcript" and opaque "claude -p ..." labels without the exact prompt text, input anchor payload, or any explicit Codex command/transcript reference, so an auditor cannot replay the skipped-positive-path decision or the claimed same-anchor dual-host review. Persist the exact shell commands/prompts/inputs and the explicit receipt-ref absence check in verificationEvidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by adding .koala/story/actives/B-51f6/evidence/staging-readiness-audit.md with exact Codex commands/outputs, exact Claude prompts, anchor payload, corrected Claude BLOCKED verdict, and receipt-ref absence check; refreshed CHK-001/CHK-002/CHK-003 verificationEvidence to reference this file and exact replay commands.

findings.desc: The story claims this worktree isolated eight unrelated dirty files from Orchestrate main, but no persisted baseline names those files or records the source git-status snapshot. After main becomes clean, that isolation claim is no longer independently auditable. Record the exact dirty-file list or the captured `git -C <main-root> status --short` output alongside the story evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by recording the original eight-file dirty baseline in .koala/story/actives/B-51f6/evidence/staging-readiness-audit.md, plus the current unrelated main untracked file and the fact it was not copied into the story worktree.

findings.desc: Current main is not an ancestor of story/B-51f6, and `git diff main..HEAD` still contains 12 non-story files outside `.koala/story/actives/B-51f6/**`. That violates the requirement that this branch stay isolated to story metadata and any strictly necessary allowlist updates. Merge/rebase current main into the story branch and re-check that only B-51f6 metadata remains in the final diff.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by merging current main into story/B-51f6. Verified git merge-base --is-ancestor main HEAD returns 0 and git diff --name-only main..HEAD contains only .koala/story/actives/B-51f6 metadata paths.

findings.desc: Coverage gap in CHK-003 same-anchor evidence: staging-readiness-audit.md records exact commands and Claude prompts, but the persisted anchor payload is incomplete for the claimed same-anchor dual-host review. The audit includes authorityUrl, policy/serverKey fields, digests, and HEAD, but it does not persist materialHash, targetPhase as an explicit anchor field, receipt-ref path/consumed receipt id as explicit unavailable anchors, or the job/run/evidence-digest anchor set required by CHK-003 context. See staging-readiness-audit.md lines 282-292 and 1-30/232-247: the prompt anchor list and audit summary do not serialize the full requested anchor payload, so CHK-003:happy:0 is not fully evidenced.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by adding a Same-Anchor Payload JSON section to .koala/story/actives/B-51f6/evidence/staging-readiness-audit.md. It explicitly records targetPhase=TEST, headHash, materialHash, receiptRefPath=authority-receipt-refs.json with unavailable_readiness_blocked status, consumedReceiptId=null/unavailable, and jobId/runId/signedEvidenceDigest/gateInputDigest/decisionDigest as null/unavailable_readiness_blocked. Refreshed CHK-003 verificationEvidence commands to read this payload.
